{"code": "import numpy as np

# Use numpy to compute standard error manually
n_control = df_clean[df_clean['arm'] == 'control'].shape[0]
n_treatment = df_clean[df_clean['arm'] == 'treatment'].shape[0]

p_control = df_clean[df_clean['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
p_treatment = df_clean[df_clean['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()

diff = p_treatment - p_control

# Standard error of difference in proportions
se_diff = np.sqrt( 
    (p_treatment * (1 - p_treatment) / n_treatment) + 
    (p_control * (1 - p_control) / n_control) 
)

# 95% confidence interval
z = 1.96
lower = diff - z * se_diff
upper = diff + z * se_diff

print(f"Control response rate: {p_control:.4f}")
print(f"Treatment response rate: {p_treatment:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (treatment - control): {diff:.4f}")
print(f"95% CI: [{lower:.4f}, {upper:.4f}]")"}
